mine-luis.observed_description: At the fair Luis now holds the black smartphone and presses his other hand on his chest, smiling at Ana, whose hands are open and empty; phone and hand-on-chest read at 250 px and stay inside the 4:5 crop.

yours-ana.observed_description: At the fair Ana holds out a closed blue book toward Luis, who reaches for it with a pleased smile; no phone; the book and both people stay inside the centered 4:5 crop.

our-car.observed_description: A smiling couple stand at the driver door of their blue hatchback in a home driveway; the woman holds up the key, the man's arm is around her; blank plate; couple and most of the car stay in the 4:5 crop.

our-grandchildren.observed_description: Grandparents sit on a living-room sofa beside their two standing grandchildren, a boy and a girl; the grandmother gestures toward the children while all four smile at the camera; the 4:5 crop keeps the grandmother and both children.

their-grandmother.observed_description: In a sunny garden two grandchildren, a girl and a boy, hug their laughing white-haired grandmother from both sides; all three faces clear at 180 px and inside the centered 4:5 crop.

their-house.observed_description: Seen from across a quiet street, a family of four waves from the front path of a pale-yellow single-story house with a red door; the whole house is clear at 180 px and the 4:5 crop keeps the house and family.

review-their-car.observed_description: Across a supermarket parking lot two older men with a shopping cart load bags into the open trunk of their green sedan; car and men clear at 250 px; the 4:5 crop keeps both men and most of the car.

review-diego-bag.observed_description: Diego (curly dark hair, short beard, dark jacket over a burgundy shirt) smiles on a modern train platform with a large dark-green travel bag over his shoulder; bag and face inside the 4:5 crop.

review-sofia-yours.observed_description: In a café Sofia (curly hair, blue blazer) hands a black smartphone to a seated young man in a grey sweater who reaches for it, surprised; phone and both faces inside the centered 4:5 crop.

gate-yours-question.observed_description: At the evening courtyard dinner table Ana leans in and holds a black smartphone up toward Luis with a questioning smile; Sofia and Diego unchanged; phone and both faces readable at 250 px.

gate-yours-answer.observed_description: Luis in the navy T-shirt sits in the foreground holding a black smartphone at chest height with his other hand flat on his chest, smiling; Ana, Sofia and Diego unchanged behind him.
